home.hero_desc: AgroGuard is a low-cost decision support platform empowering farmers with real-time sensor analytics, water conservation intelligence, and localized crop advisories.
home.intro_p1: Modern farming faces the critical challenges of freshwater scarcity, fluctuating soil health, and unpredictable climate patterns. AgroGuard bridges the gap by providing an affordable, localized IoT decision engine.
home.intro_p2: Our system utilizes sub-surface sensor arrays and cellular gateways to process soil moisture, weather predictions, and crop parameters. The data feeds directly into our recommendation algorithm, recommending actions that reduce water waste by up to 40%.
home.core_desc: Explore how AgroGuard transforms raw environmental data into actionable agronomic insights.
home.moisture_desc: Real-time volumetric water content telemetry prevents crop root drowning and prevents soil desiccation through smart thresholds.
home.irrigation_desc: Generates irrigation schedules dynamically, combining current ambient conditions with future precipitation forecast details.
home.health_desc: Computes holistic health index values for your plots based on multiple criteria: moisture levels, evaporation rates, and weather trends.
home.teaser_p1: Gain absolute visibility into your farming inputs. Our responsive dashboard displays live sensor status readings, tank capacities, and crop suggestions based on active soil parameters.
home.teaser_p2: Equipped with automatic logic, the dashboard acts as your remote agricultural control hub. Test irrigation sequences or configure automatic rules with a single toggle switch.

about.hero_subtitle: Discover how low-cost IoT sensor architecture and cloud advisory nodes are reshaping agricultural practices for small-scale farming plots.
about.problem_intro: Agricultural sectors worldwide face severe resource constraints and unpredictable shifts due to changing weather models. Traditional farming relies on generic techniques, resulting in:
about.problem_water: Water Inefficiency: Over-watering crops washes away vital soil nutrients and depletes local water reservoirs.
about.problem_finance: Financial Barriers: Commercial smart agriculture instrumentation is expensive and complex, keeping it out of reach for small farmers.
about.problem_yield: Sub-optimal Yields: Lack of real-time insights leads to crop diseases, root rot, and general soil degradation.
about.problem_manual: Manual Overhead: Farmers spend hours physically checking fields, drawing attention away from high-value tasks.
about.solution_intro: AgroGuard introduces a low-cost, plug-and-play decision support node that simplifies resource allocation through edge computing:
about.solution_drip: Volumetric Drip Automation: Saves up to 40% of irrigation water by activating pumps only when moisture levels dip below computed minimums.
about.solution_cost: Low-cost Implementation: Built on open-source IoT microcontrollers, costing a fraction of commercial alternatives.
about.solution_advisory: Micro-advisories: Translates live environmental readings into immediate advice on fertilizer needs and optimal harvest timings.
about.solution_safeguard: Autonomous Safeguards: Embedded fail-safes monitor tank metrics and abort watering cycles when rain is detected.
about.how_desc: A seamless data pipeline bridging sub-surface soils directly to user interfaces.
about.step1_desc: A network of soil sensors captures moisture, air temperature, relative humidity, and rainfall status at the field level.
about.step2_desc: The captured data is uploaded to a Python backend. The server runs decision algorithms against the inputs.
about.step3_desc: Results are instantly rendered on our mobile-responsive dashboard, suggesting optimal watering times and crop suggestions.
about.tech_desc: A robust stack designed for maximum uptime, scalability, and minimal maintenance overhead.
about.tech_html_desc: Semantic layout combined with custom fluid CSS styles for rendering speed and compatibility.
about.tech_js_desc: Lightweight asynchronous service layers update the UI and simulate physical triggers smoothly.
about.tech_backend_desc: Lightweight server API endpoints serve JSON data and handle incoming control instructions.
about.tech_hardware_desc: ESP8266/ESP32 microcontrollers integrate moisture probes and switch water pumps autonomously.

features.hero_subtitle: An overview of the monitoring parameters, algorithmic checks, and decision rules built into AgroGuard.
features.soil_moisture_desc: Sub-surface probes measure Volumetric Water Content (VWC) to ensure optimal root zone hydration without waterlogging.
features.temp_desc: Tracks atmospheric temperature levels to identify extreme heat risks and calculate crop evapotranspiration indices.
features.humidity_desc: Monitors moisture concentrations in the air. High humidity paired with high temperature alerts farmers to fungal risks.
features.rain_desc: A sensitive digital rain detector registers initial precipitation, immediately suspending unnecessary irrigation cycles.
features.tank_desc: Ultrasonic level sensors calculate available tank volume capacity to prevent pump dry-running and energy waste.
features.advisory_desc: Fuses historical moisture datasets with live weather predictions to recommend precise volumetric watering schedules.
features.crop_rec_desc: Recommends optimal crop options (e.g. Maize, Rice, or Pulses) based on seasonal soil parameters and climate trends.
features.afhi_desc: Computes a unified score (0-100) reflecting current field wellness based on hydration, heat stress, and nutrient balance.
